messages:
Harper: Quick flag  PulseAI (recent onboarding) posted a surprise token surge overnight +220% vs baseline. Adding to QBR cost agenda and renewal watch. :warning:
Diego: Yikes. Which route? Embeds, gen, or bulk ingest?
Rita: Triage shows repeated /v1/embeddings calls from their ingest worker — looks like a requeue loop after transient 500s.
Harper: ops-bot posted the alert:
ops-bot: ALERT account=pulse_ai metric=tokens_24h change=+220% link=https://app.redwood/alerts/pa-2201
Diego: Can someone run a quick 24h snapshot + 30d projection so we can model exposure for the QBR?
Rita: Running quick query:
```
SELECT SUM(tokens) as t24 FROM usage WHERE account_id='pulse_ai' AND ts > now()-24h;
```
Result: 5.0M tokens in 24h. If sustained ~150M / 30d.
Harper: Oof. Estimated spend at current tier ~ $4.5k/mo if sustained. Let's apply a soft guard and schedule enablement before the QBR.
Diego: I'll add conservative vs sustained forecasts to the QBR slides and flag renewal risk. Suggest we also prep an options list: 1) enablement call + checklist, 2) short-term throttle + model fallback, 3) one-time goodwill credit (if they were unaware).
Rita: Applied a soft quota on /v1/embeddings (2.0M/day) and rolled non-critical pipelines to a cheaper quantized embed model. ops-bot confirms.
ops-bot: NOTE guard applied route=/v1/embeddings account=pulse_ai soft_limit=2000000 tokens/day. Ticket=CS-9017
Harper: Can you lead the enablement session, Rita? Focus on batching, idempotency, and exponential backoff. Capture any product asks (client helper lib) for the post-call notes.
Rita: Yep, can do tomorrow 11am PT. I'll prepare a 15m deck and a 1-page checklist.
Diego: Owners: billing forecast + QBR slides (Diego), throttle & fallback (ops), enablement + checklist (Rita), renewal note + customer comms (Harper).
Harper: Marking renewal risk: "monitoring; engage and remediate". Will update after the enablement and decide on credit vs paid enablement. :white_check_mark:
